title: Wiki

upgradeRequired: Update KCoder on this target to use Wiki.
disabled: Wiki is off. Your saved knowledge is retained.
enableHint: A quiet place for your documents, connected ideas and knowledge that grows with you.
enabledHint: Available when you choose to use it. Ordinary conversations do not search automatically.

empty: Create a space for your sources and the ideas they connect.
welcomeTitle: A home for what you know
disabledHint: Retrieval and organization can be enabled separately. Turning either off keeps your content.
pagesHint: Organized topics and connected ideas will appear here.
sourcesHint: Original documents stay separate, so you can always check the evidence.
importHint: TXT, Markdown, HTML (.html/.htm), PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PPT (.pptx), PNG/JPEG/WebP. Documents: 32 MiB; images: 10 MiB, using native model vision without OCR. Extracted text is limited to 8 MiB; oversized extraction is rejected explicitly.
batchLimit: Select up to 10 files and 128 MiB per batch.

encodingError: {{name}}: save as UTF-8 or UTF-16 before importing.
jobError: Organization did not finish. Retry after checking the target model and source.
reviewHint: Check the proposed content before applying it. Existing page versions are retained.

jobErrors.invalid_model_output: The model returned an invalid Wiki result. Sources are retained; you can retry.
jobErrors.model_output_truncated: The model output was cut off before the proposal was complete.
jobErrors.context_budget_exceeded: This batch exceeds the current context budget. Progress is retained.
jobErrors.provider_error: The model request failed. Check the target model configuration or connection.
jobErrors.revision_conflict: The page changed after this suggestion was prepared. Generate an updated suggestion.
jobErrors.invalid_evidence: A proposed citation could not be verified against the source. Nothing was applied.
jobErrors.budget_exceeded: The model call budget is exhausted. Progress is saved.
jobErrors.source_removed: Source moved to trash; historical evidence is retained.
jobErrors.source_updated: A new source version is available. Organize it from Original sources.
jobErrors.configuration_changed: Organization settings changed. Start a new task from Original sources.

editHint: Your edits are saved as a new version. Future model changes will need your review.
restoreHint: Restoring creates a new version. Existing history is kept.
selectVersion: Select a version to preview its contents.
humanEdited: This page includes your edits; automatic changes require review.
archiveHint: This Wiki is archived. Your sources and history are retained. Restore it to continue.
noSearchResults: No matching evidence. Try a different phrase.
archiveLimit: Wiki backups must be no larger than 64 MiB.
purposeHint: Describe topics, structure and language. Changing guidance pauses active jobs; reorganize selected sources when ready.
sourceActionsHint: Updates and removal keep earlier evidence. Existing knowledge pages are not overwritten.
removedSourceHint: This source is in the trash. Historical citations remain readable.
sourceUpdated: New source version saved. Organize it when ready.
organizationStarted: Organization started. You can close this preview.
errorConflict: Content changed. Refresh and review the latest version before saving.
errorNeedsText: No extractable text. Provide a text version, or export pages as images for native vision import; OCR is not automatic.
errorEncoding: Save this document as UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16, then import again.
errorSize: This file or operation exceeds its size limit. Use smaller files or batches.
errorUnavailable: This item is unavailable or archived. Refresh the Wiki to check its state.
errorRequest: The operation did not finish. Check the selected target and try again.
invalidMarkdownBundle: Invalid Markdown package. Use a Wiki export and keep its manifest and filenames.
organizationFinished: Organization completed. Your knowledge pages are up to date.
dismissTask: Cancel this task; keep saved pages
linksLimited: Showing up to 20 links. Search the Wiki to explore further.
retrievalDisabled: Wiki retrieval is off. Organization can remain on.
organizationDisabled: Wiki organization is off. Existing knowledge can still be retrieved.
directoryHint: Preview documents and images in a local or SSH target folder, then select up to 10 files and 128 MiB total. Subfolders and hidden files are excluded.
statusRetrying: Task status is temporarily unavailable. Reconnecting…
errorVision: Select a model with native vision enabled before importing images.
errorImageSmall: Image is too small: the shortest edge must be at least 32 pixels. Provide a clearer image.
errorFormat: Unsupported or encrypted file. Save Office files as unencrypted .docx, .xlsx or .pptx, or choose a supported document/image format.
imageLimit: {{name}}: images must be PNG/JPEG/WebP and at most 10 MiB. Resize or compress the image.
